name: Gamer, una vida más
overview: Oscar, a 45-year-old man in crisis after his separation, used to be a champion of online games but was displaced by Rebo. Years later, Oscar decides to play again and captures the attention of a gaming group called the Warriors who want him for his team and seek to qualify for the most important online tournament in Argentina. However, Oscar realizes that his rival from the past, Rebo, will also be in the competition and will accept the young people's proposal to face him again.
